title: Innovations & Performance
intro: Get to know the technology behind the Axis ride. Explore wave shaping, rider controls and a helm designed around time on the water.

sections.title: Surf Band®
sections.body: Adjust key riding settings from your wrist, including surf side, speed and audio. Ask the team about compatible equipment.

sections.title: Surf Gate®
sections.body: Switch the surf wave from one side to the other. Pair the system with Power Wedge III to adjust the shape of your ride.

title: Axis Dash
intro: Get the essentials in view. The Axis Dash brings riding controls and boat information together at the helm.

sections.title: A clear view of your day
sections.body: The 7-inch touchscreen brings together surf controls, rider presets, ballast, cruise and audio. Physical controls complement the screen for quick adjustments.

sections.title: Set up for the next rider
sections.body: Use the available presets as a starting point, then adjust the settings for your crew. Ask the team to walk you through the controls on a demonstration.

title: Monsoon Engines
intro: Power designed around the pull. Explore the engine family behind Axis wake and surf boats.

sections.title: Built for watersports
sections.body: Developed with GM Marine, Monsoon engines focus on the torque and response needed for towing riders. The right engine choice depends on your model and how you use your boat.

sections.title: Choose your configuration
sections.body: Compare the published engine range on each model page, then confirm New Zealand options, servicing and equipment with Action Water Sports.

title: Owner Resources
intro: Support for the days ahead. Find owner manuals and talk to your local team about your boat.

sections.title: Your New Zealand support team
sections.body: For service, parts and warranty enquiries, contact Action Water Sports. Have your model, model year and hull identification details ready so the team can help with your specific boat.

sections.title: Know your boat
sections.body: Use the official Axis owner manual library to find the manual for your model year. Confirm the correct edition before relying on operating or maintenance instructions.

title: Athletes & Ambassadors
intro: Meet the riders and people connected by life on the water.

sections.title: Meet the Axis crew
sections.body: Explore the official Axis athlete and ambassador profiles, with stories from the wider wake and surf community.

title: Wake Responsibly
intro: A good day on the water starts with consideration for the people and places around you.

sections.title: Respect your surroundings
sections.body: Plan for the conditions, follow local rules and give other water users and the shoreline plenty of space. Speak to the local harbourmaster about the requirements where you ride.

sections.title: Keep learning
sections.body: Explore Axis’s international Wake Responsibly resources alongside the guidance that applies to your local waterway.

title: Axis Lifestyle & Blog
intro: Stories, ownership ideas and more reasons to get out on the water.

sections.title: Inside the Axis community
sections.body: Read owner stories, product guides and riding inspiration on the official international Axis blog.

title: Axis Newsroom
intro: Keep up with the latest from Axis Wake.

sections.title: News from Axis
sections.body: Explore announcements and product news from the international brand. Confirm local model availability and equipment with Action Water Sports.
